All proposed commands require source/header/compiler identity on the future integrated freeze and exact selected RUN/leaf counts; zero matching tests or platform skips are not coverage.
F291/R145 source witness log labels are historical old-base expressions; these controls do not accept composed F/retention arithmetic.
